events.content:
Implemented the notification toggle. The Server Action stores the preference in a cookie and calls Next.js’s `refresh()` to update the current page without redirecting. The [settings page](/workspace/app/page.tsx) reads the cookie and shows the updated state; I also added the required [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx).

`npm run build` passes. I submitted the form twice and confirmed the page changed off → on → off, with no redirect response. Because this starter app has no account or database layer, the preference is stored per browser.
